title: Mammalian Cell Culture: Refreshing Media
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3qzgmx6
materials: Assess cell health under light microscope before beginning.

steps.title: Remove old media
steps.instruction: Remove old media from the flask using a serological pipet and transfer it to a waste beaker.

substeps.instruction: Hold the flask with the lid pointed up to facilitate complete liquid removal
Avoid touching the pipette tip to any surface to prevent contamination

steps.title: Wash cells with DPBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cells using warmed DPBS, repeating the process for a total of 2 washes.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 4 mL warmed DPBS into the flask (use 1 mL for T-25 flask)
Remove DPBS and dispose of it into a waste beaker

steps.title: Add fresh culture media
steps.instruction: Pipette warmed cell culture media into the flask.

substeps.instruction: Use 8 mL - 12 mL for standard flasks

steps.title: Sterilize and incubate
steps.instruction: Spray the flask generously with 70% ethanol solution before placing it in the CO2 incubator.
